items.title: The Secret History
items.creator: Donna Tartt
items.notes: Shared demo book used only as sample content.

items.title: Midsommar
items.creator: Ari Aster
items.notes: Shared demo movie used only as sample content.

items.title: Blue
items.creator: Joni Mitchell
items.notes: Shared demo album used only as sample content.

items.title: Dune
items.creator: Frank Herbert
items.notes: A huge science fiction story with politics, family conflict, religion, ecology and power. I liked the world building and the feeling that every decision has consequences.

items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.creator: Jane Austen
items.notes: A classic romance with clever dialogue and strong character development. I would use this to show the Romance filter and also to talk about social expectations.

items.title: Gone Girl
items.creator: Gillian Flynn
items.notes: A dark thriller about marriage, media and manipulation. The story changes direction several times and works well for testing Mystery and Thriller filters.

items.title: The Hobbit
items.creator: J. R. R. Tolkien
items.notes: A fantasy adventure that feels lighter than The Lord of the Rings. I am using it as an in-progress example for the Books filter.

items.title: The Diary of a Young Girl
items.creator: Anne Frank
items.notes: A planned biography/history read. I added it so the Planned status and Biography/Historical genres can be tested.

items.title: Arrival
items.creator: Denis Villeneuve
items.notes: A quiet science fiction film about language, time and grief. It is emotional without being too loud, and it fits both Sci-Fi and Drama.

items.title: Knives Out
items.creator: Rian Johnson
items.notes: A funny mystery movie with a very clear visual style. Good for showing that one item can have both Mystery and Comedy.

items.title: Little Women
items.creator: Greta Gerwig
items.notes: A warm historical drama about sisters, creativity and growing up. I added it to test movie items that are not only action or fantasy.

items.title: Get Out
items.creator: Jordan Peele
items.notes: A planned horror/thriller movie. I added it so the Horror filter has a movie example in Bea's account.

items.title: Spirited Away
items.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
items.notes: A fantasy movie with beautiful animation and a dreamlike world. It is a good example for Fantasy and also for a favorite movie list.

items.title: Folklore
items.creator: Taylor Swift
items.notes: A calm album with storytelling, soft production and many emotional songs. I use it to demo music items and the Indie filter.

items.title: Random Access Memories
items.creator: Daft Punk
items.notes: An album that feels polished, shiny and very produced. Good for showing variety in the music section.

items.title: Lemonade
items.creator: Beyonce
items.notes: A powerful album with a strong visual and emotional concept. I am using it as an in-progress music example.

items.title: Planet Earth II
items.creator: BBC
items.notes: A nature documentary series that I want to watch properly. It is useful for testing the Documentary genre.

items.title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
items.creator: Taylor Jenkins Reid
items.notes: A dramatic romance about fame, identity and private life. Lola uses this as one of her favorite books.

items.title: Educated
items.creator: Tara Westover
items.notes: A memoir about family, education and becoming independent. It is a clear Biography item for testing that filter.

items.title: The Thursday Murder Club
items.creator: Richard Osman
items.notes: A cozy mystery with older characters solving a case. It is lighter than most thrillers and good for Mystery plus Comedy.

items.title: Mexican Gothic
items.creator: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
items.notes: A gothic horror book on Lola's planned list. It helps test Horror, Mystery and Planned status.

items.title: The Martian
items.creator: Andy Weir
items.notes: A funny and practical science fiction survival story. Useful for testing Sci-Fi and Comedy together.

items.title: Barbie
items.creator: Greta Gerwig
items.notes: A colorful comedy with social commentary and a very strong visual style. Lola uses it as a fun movie example.

items.title: Parasite
items.creator: Bong Joon-ho
items.notes: A thriller and drama about class difference. The tone changes in a surprising way, so it is useful for testing Thriller and Drama.

items.title: Interstellar
items.creator: Christopher Nolan
items.notes: A big science fiction movie about space, family and time. Lola has started it but not finished it yet.

items.title: The Conjuring
items.creator: James Wan
items.notes: A planned horror movie for a scary movie night list. It makes the Horror filter easy to demonstrate.

items.title: Won't You Be My Neighbor?
items.creator: Morgan Neville
items.notes: A kind documentary about Fred Rogers. Lola added it for the Documentary filter and for a gentle watchlist.

items.title: Melodrama
items.creator: Lorde
items.notes: A dramatic pop album about parties, heartbreak and growing up. Lola uses it as a favorite music item.

items.title: Ctrl
items.creator: SZA
items.notes: A personal album with honest lyrics and a relaxed sound. It is good for showing Lola's music taste.

items.title: Currents
items.creator: Tame Impala
items.notes: A psychedelic album Lola is still listening through. It works well for the Albums format and In Progress status.

items.title: Hamilton
items.creator: Lin-Manuel Miranda
items.notes: A musical soundtrack Lola wants to listen to properly from beginning to end. It uses Historical and Drama as music genres.
